# epilot-kanban Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    epilot-kanban = {
      source  = "epilot-dev/epilot-kanban"
      version = "0.16.10"
    }
  }
}

provider "epilot-kanban" {
  # Configuration options
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `epilot_auth` (String, Sensitive) Authorization header with epilot OAuth2 bearer token.
- `epilot_org` (String, Sensitive) Overrides the target organization to allow shared tenantaccess.
- `server_url` (String) Server URL (defaults to https://kanban.sls.epilot.io)
